svg.aria-label: Figure 1, a year in halftone: Each dot is a day, inked by its contributions: 2,525 in all, on 189 of 365 days. Longest streak 32 days; the busiest day was 22 November, with 124. Dot area on a square-root scale; the rule marks today.
